title: Reelem Inn | KEY.co
description_expanded: This exquisite three-bedroom townhome offers a perfect blend of luxury and comfort, ideal for families and pet lovers alike. The expansive living area, featuring a large Smart TV, invites relaxation and entertainment, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and adjacent dining area sets the stage for memorable meals. Each bedroom is a haven of tranquility, with the primary suite boasting a king bed and en suite bath, the second bedroom offering a plush queen bed, and the third bedroom delighting with a cozy bunk bed. The convenience of a half bathroom on the main level and a full-size washer/dryer ensures a seamless stay. Guests can enjoy the ease of walking or biking everywhere, thanks to a 17-mile bike path that connects the vibrant local scene. High-speed Wi-Fi keeps everyone connected, while the serene outdoor setting offers a peaceful retreat. Whether you’re starting your day with a bike ride along the scenic path, lounging in the spacious living area, or resting in one of the well-appointed bedrooms, this townhome provides an unparalleled vacation experience on 30A. Embrace the coastal lifestyle in a home designed for ultimate comfort and convenience, where every detail has been thoughtfully curated for an unforgettable stay.
